# anthropic_plugin_installation_setting (Resource)

Manages who may use an organization-owned plugin, for the whole organization or for one group, through the Plugins API beta `ce-plugins-2026-09-01`.

The Plugins API is available only to Claude Enterprise organizations, and not
with HIPAA readiness enabled. It accepts an API key created in claude.ai under
Organization settings > API (`sk-ant-api01-...`), not an Admin API key.
Reads need the `read:plugins` scope and writes need `write:plugins`,
which does not grant reads, so the key needs both.

A `target` of `organization` sets the plugin's own organization-wide
setting, which stops the plugin inheriting its marketplace's default even when
the value is the same. A group's `rbac_group_...` ID sets that group's
setting, which replaces the organization-wide value for its members.

The API upserts on set, so creating this resource refuses to take over a
setting the target already holds; import that setting instead. Destroying this
resource removes the setting: for `organization` the plugin inherits its
marketplace's default again, and a group's members fall back to the
organization-wide value. A setting removed outside Terraform is created again
on the next apply. Send writes for one plugin from one configuration: the API
can answer concurrent writes for the same plugin with `503`, which the
provider retries.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "anthropic" {
  alias   = "plugins"
  api_key = var.anthropic_plugins_api_key
}

resource "anthropic_plugin_installation_setting" "linter_organization" {
  provider                = anthropic.plugins
  plugin_id               = "plugin_01Hq3vX8kZcN2mB7pR4tY9wL"
  target                  = "organization"
  installation_preference = "available"
}

resource "anthropic_plugin_installation_setting" "linter_pilot" {
  provider                = anthropic.plugins
  plugin_id               = "plugin_01Hq3vX8kZcN2mB7pR4tY9wL"
  target                  = "rbac_group_01KwZpXvRtYqNmLs8cDf3HgJ"
  installation_preference = "required"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `installation_preference` (String) What members of the target get: `required` (installed and cannot be removed), `auto_install` (installed and can be removed), `available` (installed on request) or `not_available` (hidden). The API validates the value, so a value it adds later works without a provider release.
- `plugin_id` (String) ID of an organization-owned plugin. A member-owned plugin has shares instead and returns `404`.
- `target` (String) Whose setting this is: `organization`, or the `rbac_group_...` ID of a group the organization can see in `/v1/organizations/rbac_groups`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of when the target was first given a setting for this plugin.
- `id` (String) `<plugin_id>/<target>`.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of when the setting last changed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import anthropic_plugin_installation_setting.linter_organization plugin_01Hq3vX8kZcN2mB7pR4tY9wL/organization
terraform import anthropic_plugin_installation_setting.linter_pilot plugin_01Hq3vX8kZcN2mB7pR4tY9wL/rbac_group_01KwZpXvRtYqNmLs8cDf3HgJ
```
